title: Circuit-family evaluation and language membership
statement: Let $F$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits, let $N$ be a natural number, and let $q$ be a Boolean string of length $N$. The circuit in the family for inputs of length $N$, evaluated on the length-$N$ input whose $i$th bit is the $i$th bit of $q$ (or false when that index is out of range), outputs true if and only if $q$ belongs to the language recognized by the family.
